import hashlib,itertools,json,statistics,subprocess,cProfile,pstats,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import patch
from benchmarks import compiler_cz_identity_prefix as control
from flagquantum.compiler.lowering import native_block_optimization as blocks
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import _cz_blocks
root=Path.cwd();harness=Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121');source_path='flagquantum/compiler/optimization/_cz_blocks.py'
old_source=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+source_path],timeout=15)
old=ModuleType('flagquantum.compiler.optimization._cz_cost_pruning_control');sys.modules[old.__name__]=old;exec(compile(old_source,'historical-native-blocks','exec'),old.__dict__)
new_candidate=blocks._candidate
original_compile=control._COMPILE
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=15).strip()==control._HARNESS
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=harness,text=True,timeout=15).strip()
output=Path('/private/tmp/fq-cz-cost-pruning-validation-20261122.json')
report={'scope':'Within-SDK single-device inspected development controls; no qualified latency/RSS, held-out or ranking claim','implementation_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True,timeout=15).strip(),'source_commit':control._HARNESS,'baseline_sha256':hashlib.sha256(old_source).hexdigest(),'runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(source_path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'complete':False,'rows':[],'failures':[],'timing':[],'profile':[]}
def observe(case,mode,memory=False):
 captured=[]
 def compile_capture(*args,**kwargs):
  result=original_compile(*args,**kwargs);captured.append(result);return result
 with patch.object(blocks,'_candidate',old._candidate if mode=='baseline' else new_candidate),patch.object(control,'_COMPILE',compile_capture):observation=control._observe(case,harness,memory)
 assert len(captured)==1
 stage=captured[0].legalization.native_block_optimization
 observation['rejection_counts']=dict(stage.rejection_counts)
 observation['optimization_identity']=stage.optimization_identity
 observation['target_snapshot_id']=stage.target_snapshot_id
 observation['rewrites']=[asdict(rewrite) for rewrite in stage.rewrites]
 return observation
def stable(row):return {k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ('seconds','python_peak_bytes','optimization_identity','target_snapshot_id')}
for case in itertools.product((6,8,12),('qaoa','ising','hopping','qft','repetition'),('line','ring','grid','sparse')):
 try:
  before=observe(case,'baseline');after=observe(case,'candidate');equal=stable(before)==stable(after)
  report['rows'].append({'case':case,'baseline':before,'candidate':after,'identical':equal})
  if not equal:report['failures'].append({'case':case,'message':'Complete normalized output or metrics differ'})
 except Exception as error:report['failures'].append({'case':case,'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)})
 output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(case,'inspected',flush=True)
for case in ((6,'qft','grid'),(6,'repetition','ring'),(12,'qft','grid')):
 samples={'baseline':[],'candidate':[]};references={};memory={}
 for iteration in range(9):
  for mode in (('baseline','candidate') if iteration%2==0 else ('candidate','baseline')):
   observation=observe(case,mode)
   if mode not in references:references[mode]=stable(observation)
   assert stable(observation)==references[mode]
   if iteration>=2:samples[mode].append(observation['seconds'])
 for mode in samples:
  observation=observe(case,mode,True);assert stable(observation)==references[mode];memory[mode]=observation['python_peak_bytes']
  profile=cProfile.Profile();profile.enable();observation=observe(case,mode);profile.disable();assert stable(observation)==references[mode]
  functions=[]
  for (file,line,name),(primitive,calls,self_time,cumulative,callers) in pstats.Stats(profile).stats.items():
   if name in ('read','_numeric_matrix','_lifted_matrix','_scalar_angle','_candidate','synthesize_two_qubit','verify_native_block_optimization') and ('compiler' in file or file=='historical-native-blocks'):functions.append({'file':file,'line':line,'function':name,'primitive_calls':primitive,'calls':calls,'self_seconds':self_time,'cumulative_seconds':cumulative})
  report['profile'].append({'case':case,'variant':mode,'functions':functions})
 report['timing'].append({'case':case,'samples_seconds':samples,'median_seconds':{k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in samples.items()},'python_traced_peak_bytes':memory,'outputs':references});output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print('timing',case,report['timing'][-1]['median_seconds'],memory,flush=True)
report['complete']=True;output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');raise SystemExit(bool(report['failures']))
